objective: Advance the full user-authorized fresh-network PQC switch by executing owner-provided private BN254 input through actual seven-party native proof and canonical settlement. This is a laboratory execution dependency, not a replacement for real QOMM/OCLOB integration.
bottleneck: Owned native whole-path001 succeeded, but the worker read a private plaintext share file rather than the existing authenticated encrypted input packet.
whole_candidate: Generate distinct laboratory sender and seven recipient keys in separate key-owner processes. A separate owner process reads six clear values, Shamir-shares and signs/hybrid-encrypts each recipient packet. The native coordinator launches workers using only ciphertext file paths, manifest-pinned registration snapshots and operator-local key paths. Each worker checks owner/recipient registration, actual clock and policy before authentication/decryption, durably consumes the semantic input operation, then executes the already verified owned native proof and canonical fill/recovered no-fill/negative path. No raw share fallback.
likely_prediction_error: A worker-local registration, private key path, clock or durable consumption mismatch may reject the packet before its owned initializer can execute.
population: Same laboratory six-field book/cohort as owned-native001, with fresh registered sender/recipient keys and signed encrypted packets instead of plaintext shares. The main run does not mount the owner's original values or signing seed. Seven laboratory operators still share one host; receiver key files are a lab adapter, not independent custody or production encrypted keystores.
negative_gates: altered or incomplete canonical proof chunks
invalid private product or negative balance
rejection_rule: Any missing actual owned-worker path, accepted required negative, mismatched authoritative commitment, fallback fixture execution, missing proof/canonical evidence or weakened verification rejects this run.
promotion_rule: At most smoke_only. Operational account/role/order authorization, QOMM/OCLOB matching constraints and canonical operational integration, meaningful Off, independent operator custody, crash recovery of consumed inputs, and formal composition/concrete PQ parameters remain unresolved.
preflight: Pin exact contract, manifest, launch config, public bindings, roster and executable hashes; atomically claim a fresh output and immediately run the whole candidate.
postflight: Write public receipts/proofs and input identities excluding private fields/keys/shares; append one verdict preserving prior records.
additional_delivery_verification: After the whole observation, deterministic tests must reject wrong recipient, tampering, wrong policy/operation and re-encrypted semantic replay, including restart. Invalid packets must not consume the input authorization. Public-only proof verification uses a no-private-mount container.
